# The Night Watch

*Keep watch with Vosk and Brakka at the far anchor of the canyon bridge through the night, and find out what gnaws the ropes. Hold until dawn. Potions work out there; scrolls do not.*

Dying ends the run.

## 1. The Far Anchor at Night

Map: [The Far Anchor at Night](../maps/far_anchor_night.md)

- Hold the anchor until dawn

Wave 1: 3 [Cliff Gnawer](../monsters/cliff_gnawer.md)

Wave 2: 1 [Wild Boar](../monsters/wild_boar.md)

## Rewards (Normal)
